name: Rephaim
overview: The Rephaim were an ancient people of great stature, often described as giants, who inhabited parts of Palestine. Scripture identifies them alongside other formidable groups such as the Emims and Zamzummims, emphasizing their size and strength (Genesis 14:5; Deuteronomy 2:11, 2:20). The territory associated with the Rephaim included regions like Bashan, ruled by King Og, whose enormous iron bedstead highlights their extraordinary size (Deuteronomy 3:11, 3:13). Additionally, the Rephaim are connected to a valley marking the boundary between Judah and Benjamin, noted as the battleground of David and the Philistines, underscoring their historical and geographical significance.
